list.title: Documents
list.emptyDescription: Add a PDF or paste a link (Notion, Loom, Figma…), then create one link per prospect.
list.description: Drop a PDF or paste a link anywhere in Clozer to add it, or use “Add a document” at the top.
list.sentLinkCount: {count, plural, =1 {# link sent} other {# links sent}}
list.failed: Analysis failed. Open the document to see why.

detail.prospectLinks: {count, plural, =1 {# prospect link} other {# prospect links}}
detail.analyzing: Analyzing the document, a few seconds…
detail.emptyTitle: Create one link for each prospect.
detail.emptyVideo: Send it instead of a Loom link. You'll see who watches it, how far, and Clozer will follow up for you.
detail.emptyWeb: Send it instead of the original link. You'll see who opens it, how long they spend on it, and Clozer will follow up for you.
detail.emptyPdf: Send it instead of the PDF. You'll see who opens it, how long they read, and Clozer will follow up for you.
detail.welcomeHint: seen by the prospect as soon as they open it, on every link
detail.docTypeHint: sets the wording of the tags and the assistant
detail.contentHintVideo: part by part, what Clozer understood
detail.contentHintPages: page by page, what Clozer understood
detail.frictionsHint: across all prospects of this document
detail.trackingLoom: For a Loom video, Clozer measures time spent on the page, not how much of the video was watched.
detail.trackingVideo: For a video, Clozer measures time spent and how much was actually watched (skipped parts don't count).
detail.trackingEmbed: For a web link, Clozer measures time spent on the page, with no page-by-page detail.
detail.trackingReader: This site blocks embedding: your prospects read the article inside Clozer. Clozer measures time spent and how far they read.
detail.trackingNewTab: This site opens in a new tab: Clozer sees when the prospect opens it, and estimates time spent from when they come back to the link.
detail.timeTitleVideo: Time spent on each part of the video
detail.notEnoughReading: Not enough reading yet for the page-by-page detail.
detail.recentEmpty: Nobody has opened this document yet. Reads will show up here.
detail.anonymousNote: These readers didn't give their email. Same letter, same browser; two letters, often two people (or the same person on two devices). To know exactly who's reading, turn on “Ask for email before reading” in the link settings.
detail.followupsIntro: Follow-ups for every prospect of this document. Clozer writes one when it thinks the timing is right; you review it here or on the prospect's page, then approve it.

content.videoRead: What you say in each part of the video, read by AI from the transcript. Tags tell Clozer when you talk pricing, timeline… Fix them if needed.
content.videoProcessing: Transcribing and reading the video (about a minute). Reload the page to see each part.
content.videoNoTranscript: No transcript for this video: view tracking works, but the assistant has nothing to answer from.
content.pagesRead: A summary of each page, read by AI. Tags tell Clozer where the pricing, timeline… are. Fix them if needed: your choice won't be overwritten.
content.aiGaveUp: AI couldn't read this document. Try again with “Reread pages”.
content.aiReading: AI is reading the pages (about a minute). Reload the page to see the summaries.
content.keywordTags: Tags spotted from keywords. Fix them if needed: your choice won't be overwritten.
content.webNoText: Clozer couldn't read the text on this page (content rendered by the browser, or private access).
content.webAiReading: AI is reading the page, reload in a minute.
content.descriptionIntro: What Clozer can't see on the page (video, content behind a click): describe in a few lines what it shows (offer, price, options, timeline). AI will use it to understand your deals and write follow-ups.
content.descriptionPlaceholder: Growth plan overview: audit, redesign, 3 months of support. $14,500, payable in 3 installments.
content.notesIntro: What the document doesn't say and the assistant can tell the prospect: technical details, assumptions, what's out of scope, options. Adds to what you wrote in Settings. Nothing confidential: the prospect can get all of it just by asking.
content.notesPlaceholder: The WordPress site isn't covered by the audit. Estimates are in person-days, at $650 per day. We can start within 2 weeks.

preview.noEmbed: This site blocks embedding. Your prospects will see a button to open it in a new tab.
preview.later: The preview will show once the analysis is done.
